name: Holyoke Christmas Tree Lighting and Parade of Lights
when_note: Carousel rides and characters start at 3 pm, the tree lights at 6 pm and the Parade of Lights follows.
paras: The City of Holyoke lights its Christmas tree and holds its Parade of Lights at City Hall on Saturday, December 5, 2026. The fun starts at 3 pm with free, unlimited rides on the Holyoke Merry-Go-Round, photos with Christmas characters and balloon artists from Dazzleday.

At 5 pm the action moves to City Hall for hot chocolate, cookies and popcorn, with the Holyoke High School Bell Choir and then the Madrigal Choir. At 6 pm Mayor Joshua Garcia greets families on the lawn, the tree lights up and the Parade of Lights begins.
tip: Go at 3 pm for the free carousel rides, then walk to City Hall before the 5 pm cocoa.

name: Westfield Mayor's Tree Lighting, Carols and Cocoa
address: Main and Broad Streets, Westfield, MA 01085
when_note: The event runs from 4 to 6 pm.
paras: Westfield's Mayor's Tree Lighting returns to Park Square on Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 4 to 6 pm, on Small Business Saturday. Mayor Mike McCabe hosts, with the Westfield High School Show Choir and Band and the All-Stars Dance Center Dancers.
Santa arrives, and families gather with Mrs. Claus and costumed characters. Mt. Moriah Lodge provides complimentary hot chocolate. The city lists the event as free.
tip: Santa's arrival marks the start of Westfield's holiday season, so get to Park Square early.
